comparison.repeat_variability_note: Identical control weights previously scored 43.80 on the same scene definitions; partial-score difference is not a reliable policy gain.

bounded_diagnosis.finding: First sustained regression at 20-30 s was commanded outward and physically followed; no scored contact.
bounded_diagnosis.unresolved: Actual RGB visibility and visual target recognition versus full-target action mapping, because scored bags lack synchronized RGB and pose-head outputs.

decision.next_experiment: Frozen actor synchronized observation/action trace on at most four training-only SC full starts.
decision.budget: At most one GPU and 90 minutes; no training or new development starts.
decision.continue_to_targeted_repair_if: Complete causal traces and at least three of four first sustained >=20 mm regression events support the same actionable cause.
decision.targeted_repair_if_eligible: One observation-only full-target action-head repair, at most 1500 updates on one GPU plus four matched autonomous development runs. Continue only if grouped SC offline metrics do not regress, p95 latency <300 ms, and treatment scores at least one full insertion without off-limit contact while control does not.
decision.otherwise: Stop this BC branch; if recovery is still a plausible bottleneck, propose a separately budgeted RL diagnostic exception using observable near-completion incidents.
